basic_details.short_information: Notice No.08/2026 covers contract / temporary Staff Nurse posts in Government hospitals under the Tirunelveli Health Unit District and in Comprehensive Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (CEmONC) centres, including SNCU and PICU, under the control of Tirunelveli Medical College Hospital. The posts are filled as per National Health Mission norms. The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.details: The age limit for the Staff Nurse post is up to 50 years; the conditions also say the candidate must be within 50 years of age. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation.

qualification.education_qualification: GNM or B.Sc Nursing from an Indian Nursing Council-recognised college
qualification.details: Registration with the Tamil Nadu Nursing Council is mandatory. The documents list asks for proof of residency (Voter ID, Aadhar Card, Ration Card, Driving Licence and Passport). The documents list asks for evidence of Tamil eligibility (10th or 12th standard marks). | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Staff Nurse post.

selection_process: Every application is given marks as per G.O. No.258
Health and Family Welfare Department (EAP II/2)
dated 11.09.2026. A merit list is prepared on the basis of those marks.
Only the certificates attached with the application are taken into account for preparing the merit list
so a certificate left out of the envelope cannot add marks later.
how_to_apply: Download the application form from the website https://tirunelveli.nic.in.
Attach copies of all the certificates listed below.
Send the completed application to: District Health Office, No.16/22, Old Police Hospital Road, Samathanapuram, Palayamkottai, Tirunelveli - 627002.
Make sure the application reaches the District Health Office by 5 PM on 4 December 2026.
The notice does not say whether the application should be sent by post or handed in.
Evidence of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate/SSLC/HSC Certificate).
Evidence of Education qualification and mark statement (10th, 12th, DGNM/B.Sc Nursing Mark Sheet, Degree Certificate, etc.).
Proof of Residency: Voter ID, Aadhar Card, Ration Card, Driving Licence and Passport.
Tamilnadu Nurses and Midwives Council Registration Certificate.
Evidence for Tamil Eligibility (10th or 12th std Marks).
important_instructions: The posts are purely temporary, for 11 months. The posts will not be regularised at any time. A selected candidate must give a voluntary consent letter (undertaking) for joining. The number of vacancies is subject to change. Appointment is on a contract basis as per National Health Mission norms.

content_sections.heading: DHS Tirunelveli Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: Notice No.08/2026 covers contract / temporary Staff Nurse posts in Government hospitals under the Tirunelveli Health Unit District and in Comprehensive Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (CEmONC) centres, including SNCU and PICU, under the control of Tirunelveli Medical College Hospital. The posts are filled as per National Health Mission norms. The official notification does not specify the application fee.

content_sections.heading: About DHS Tirunelveli Staff Nurse Recruitment
content_sections.text: The District Health Society, Tirunelveli works under the National Health Mission – Tamil Nadu and the Health and Family Welfare Department of the Government of Tamil Nadu. Its Chairman is the District Collector, Tirunelveli, and its Secretary is the District Health Officer, Tirunelveli. This recruitment is issued with reference to G.O. (Ms) No.427, Health and Family Welfare Department (EAP.II-1), dated 18.11.2026, and the Mission Director, NHM-TN, Chennai-06 letter No.11012724/A4/NHM/2025, dated 19.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: DHS Tirunelveli Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Applications are received at the Tirunelveli District Health Office; an application must reach the office by 5 PM on 4 December 2026.

rows.event: Last Date to Apply (application must be received)

content_sections.heading: DHS Tirunelveli Staff Nurse Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 51 Staff Nurse posts are available in Tirunelveli district. The number of vacancies is subject to change. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the 51 posts.

content_sections.heading: DHS Tirunelveli Staff Nurse Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Registration with the Tamil Nadu Nursing Council is mandatory. The documents list asks for proof of residency (Voter ID, Aadhar Card, Ration Card, Driving Licence and Passport). The documents list asks for evidence of Tamil eligibility (10th or 12th standard marks). Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Staff Nurse post.

rows.qualification_required: Diploma in Nursing (GNM) or B.Sc Nursing from a Government or Government-recognised private nursing college, recognised by the Indian Nursing Council.

content_sections.heading: DHS Tirunelveli Staff Nurse Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for the Staff Nurse post is up to 50 years; the conditions also say the candidate must be within 50 years of age. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: DHS Tirunelveli Staff Nurse Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Every application is given marks as per G.O. No.258, Health and Family Welfare Department (EAP II/2), dated 11.09.2026. A merit list is prepared on the basis of those marks. Only the certificates attached with the application are taken into account for preparing the merit list, so a certificate left out of the envelope cannot add marks later.

content_sections.heading: DHS Tirunelveli Staff Nurse Job Description 2026
content_sections.text: The Staff Nurses will work in Government hospitals under the Tirunelveli Health Unit District and in CEmONC centres, including SNCU and PICU, under the control of Tirunelveli Medical College Hospital. The notice does not list individual duties.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DHS Tirunelveli Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the website https://tirunelveli.nic.in. Fill in the application form. Attach copies of all the certificates listed below. Send the completed application to: District Health Office, No.16/22, Old Police Hospital Road, Samathanapuram, Palayamkottai, Tirunelveli - 627002. Make sure the application reaches the District Health Office by 5 PM on 4 December 2026. The notice does not say whether the application should be sent by post or handed in. Evidence of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate/SSLC/HSC Certificate). Evidence of Education qualification and mark statement (10th, 12th, DGNM/B.Sc Nursing Mark Sheet, Degree Certificate, etc.). Proof of Residency: Voter ID, Aadhar Card, Ration Card, Driving Licence and Passport. Community Certificate. Tamilnadu Nurses and Midwives Council Registration Certificate. Evidence for Tamil Eligibility (10th or 12th std Marks).

content_sections.heading: DHS Tirunelveli Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The posts are purely temporary, for 11 months. The posts will not be regularised at any time. A selected candidate must give a voluntary consent letter (undertaking) for joining. The number of vacancies is subject to change. Appointment is on a contract basis as per National Health Mission norms.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DHS Tirunelveli Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 51 contract / temporary Staff Nurse posts in Tirunelveli district, and the number of vacancies is subject to change.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the DHS Tirunelveli Staff Nurse application?
faq.answer: The application must reach the District Health Office, Tirunelveli by 5 PM on 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for DHS Tirunelveli Staff Nurse posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 50 years; the conditions also say the candidate must be within 50 years of age.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the DHS Tirunelveli Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: A Diploma in Nursing (GNM) or B.Sc Nursing from a Government or Government-recognised private nursing college recognised by the Indian Nursing Council, along with mandatory Tamil Nadu Nursing Council registration.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a DHS Tirunelveli Staff Nurse?
Q6. How are DHS Tirunelveli Staff Nurses selected?
faq.answer: Applications are given marks as per G.O. No.258, Health and Family Welfare Department (EAP II/2), dated 11.09.2026, and a merit list is prepared on that basis, using only the certificates attached with the application.

faq.question: Q7. Where should the DHS Tirunelveli Staff Nurse application be sent?
faq.answer: Download the form from https://tirunelveli.nic.in and send it to District Health Office, No.16/22, Old Police Hospital Road, Samathanapuram, Palayamkottai, Tirunelveli - 627002.

faq.question: Q8. Is the DHS Tirunelveli Staff Nurse job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely temporary for 11 months and will not be regularised at any time.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the DHS Tirunelveli Staff Nurses be posted?
faq.answer: In Government hospitals under the Tirunelveli Health Unit District and in CEmONC centres, including SNCU and PICU, under Tirunelveli Medical College Hospital.
